name: Bassoon
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: Discover your sertanejo style and create portraits inspired by Brazilian country music culture. Designed primarily for people in Brazil, Bassoon starts in Brazilian Portuguese and guides you through a photo and a short conversation. Your answers connect with five styles and Bassoon's authored art directions. Create up to three individual portraits, one at a time when you ask to continue, then refine selected portraits while preserving your likeness and the details you requested. You can request another conversation language. Uses ChatGPT's available image generation and editing tools; availability and usage limits depend on your account and current ChatGPT experience. This plugin does not connect to the event booth or upload your portraits to the event Gallery.

limitations_ja: ChatGPTの画像生成・編集ツールの利用可否と制限に依存。
